jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.

You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.

Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.

About The Job

This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.

You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.

You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD.
We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Qualifications

10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
SQL, plus Python or R.
Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
Experience in a B2C subscription business.

Core Expectations

You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.

Our Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Research- EN
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Work at the cutting edge of AI: Access to RBC's unique data assets, world-class compute infrastructure, and strategic partnerships with leading AI research institutions.
Industry-leading research environment: Publish your work, attend top-tier conferences, and collaborate with renowned researchers from RBC Borealis and beyond.
Real-world impact: Your research will directly power products and services used by millions of clients across Canada and globally.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to shape RBC's AI strategy.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, machine learning, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: Shape the future of AI at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

jobs.title: Director Data Center Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

The role is for Global Data Center engineering lead managing a high performing team of senior engineers responsible for all the networking technology running in the RBC’s global data centers including our cloud presence in Azure and AWS.

We are in 32 countries with a global network spanning Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Asia PAC and Europe. We own, manage and operate a very large and complex interconnected network from the fiber in the ground to every technology involved in delivering a service to our clients. We also manage two complex content delivery networks, Akamai and Cloudflare that serves RBC’s 13 million banking customers.

Must be familiar with AI architectural network designs, complex design architecture between applications and infrastructure, majority of the network routing protocols, complex security design principles including PAN and Checkpoint firewalls, broad cloud networking constructs i.e. global availability zones and multi-cloud options.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

You will manage engineering and certification for the following technologies.

Core data center technologies - Cisco Nexus including ACI and Arista
DNS – Infoblox
Load balancing – F5
Cloud networking – Azure and AWS
CDN – Akamai and Cloudflare

You will also need to

Manage the implementation of multiple concurrent initiatives of varying complexity in a time efficient manner. Monitor and control activities according to plan.
Continuously identify potential issues, conflicts, and risks. Analyze, mitigate and escalate where appropriate
Develop and execute on end to end change management plans and plan and execute all communication related to these.
Collaborate and contribute on cross-functional enterprise initiatives and manage the effective implementation of assigned deliverables.
Establish strong working relationships across business units and platforms to build influence and impact with key business partners. Collaborate with groups to define and achieve deliverables and ensure initiatives are effectively integrated into RBC procedures and processes.
Contribute to ongoing administrative program activities as required.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

Must have:

Undergraduate degree coupled with change management experience in complex programs with high frequency of requests and multiple priorities.
Demonstrated ability in written and oral communication skills along with strong presentation skills. Ability to determine the information and communication needs of the stakeholders and project.
Strong organizational, project management and time management capabilities.
A strong understanding of technology and/or financial services industry.
Deadline-driven and results-oriented; able to meet consistently high quality standards while handling a variety of tasks and deadlines simultaneously.

Nice-to-have
:

Ability to facilitate between and influence key decision makers
Strategic thinker with excellent interpersonal skills to work across functions and businesses

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Strategy
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274044

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Scotiabank Enterprise Strategy group is a high-performing central team focused on designing and advancing Scotiabank’s strategic agenda
. The team works closely with the CEO, Group Heads and senior leaders to shape the Bank’s enterprise strategy and its most important business-line priorities.

Reporting to the VP, Enterprise Strategy, the Director will work closely with senior executives, business-line leaders and stakeholders across the Bank to lead complex strategy engagements, generate insights and develop recommendations that shape the Bank’s most important priorities.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will be responsible for:

Strategy Projects – Must-Win Priorities
Lead a broad range of strategy engagements across the Bank, including business-line priorities and enterprise initiatives. Partner with stakeholders to structure complex problems, conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis, assess strategic and financial implications, and develop and present compelling recommendations to senior leadership.
Design and facilitate problem-solving sessions, workshops, and interviews with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts to generate insights, build alignment, and advance strategic priorities.
Build alignment across business lines and corporate functions to advance strategic priorities and drive enterprise outcomes.
Partner with business-line leaders to shape strategic priorities and support the development of plans aligned to the Bank’s broader strategic objectives.
Synthesize complex findings into clear recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and governance approaches, and present them effectively to senior leaders to drive strategic outcomes.
Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior executives, helping define priorities, assess trade-offs, and navigate complex strategic decisions.
Thought Leadership
Provide thought leadership and constructive challenge on the design and advancement of strategic priorities and must-win opportunities.
Monitor emerging trends, competitive dynamics, and strategic issues to assess their implications for the Bank and its business-line strategies.
Act as a strategic counsel and thought partner for senior executives – both within the context of strategy project and on an ongoing basis
Design and support executive strategy discussions and offsites, helping senior leaders evaluate key priorities, align on strategic direction, and address emerging opportunities and challenges.
Executive Communications
Support the CEO agenda, including all-bank strategy, business line value creation projects, strategic planning, Board-level communications, and being a trusted advisor to senior leaders
Develop clear, compelling presentations and communications that translate complex strategic issues into actionable insights for senior executives, Executive Committee, and Board audiences.
In partnership with Global Communications, develop executive communications and strategic messaging that clearly articulate the Bank's priorities to internal and external stakeholders. Support the planning and delivery of key leadership, employee, and external events.
Team Leadership and Stakeholder Management
Contribute to the growth and development of the Enterprise Strategy team through recruiting, coaching, mentorship, knowledge sharing, and fostering strong partnerships across the Bank.
Ensure the Bank's risk appetite and risk culture are appropriately considered in all activities, recommendations, and decisions.
Champion a high-performance environment and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops, and motivates top talent by fostering an inclusive work environment

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have the following:

MBA, PhD or relevant post-graduate degree from a recognized institution
3-4 years of experience in a top-tier management consulting firm; banking industry expertise is highly recommended
Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, challenging, and dynamic business environment
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to manage ambiguity
Superior interpersonal skills, leadership and influencing capabilities on a multi-cultural environment
Self-motivated; ability to work both independently and collaboratively with multi-functional teams
Experience running complex projects, with large group of cross-functional stakeholders
Ability to effectively manage relationships across the Bank, its partners, and external vendors
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
Collaborative and proven track record of managing and developing high-potential talent
Excellent knowledge of MS Office including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

What’s in it for you?

An inclusive & collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
We offer a competitive rewards package: Performance bonus, Employee Share Ownership Program, and Pension Plan Matching, Health Benefits from day one!
Your career matters! You will have access to career development and progression opportunities.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Research- EN
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Work at the cutting edge of AI: Access to RBC's unique data assets, world-class compute infrastructure, and strategic partnerships with leading AI research institutions.
Industry-leading research environment: Publish your work, attend top-tier conferences, and collaborate with renowned researchers from RBC Borealis and beyond.
Real-world impact: Your research will directly power products and services used by millions of clients across Canada and globally.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to shape RBC's AI strategy.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, machine learning, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: Shape the future of AI at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

The role is for Global Data Center engineering lead managing a high performing team of senior engineers responsible for all the networking technology running in the RBC’s global data centers including our cloud presence in Azure and AWS.

We are in 32 countries with a global network spanning Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Asia PAC and Europe. We own, manage and operate a very large and complex interconnected network from the fiber in the ground to every technology involved in delivering a service to our clients. We also manage two complex content delivery networks, Akamai and Cloudflare that serves RBC’s 13 million banking customers.

Must be familiar with AI architectural network designs, complex design architecture between applications and infrastructure, majority of the network routing protocols, complex security design principles including PAN and Checkpoint firewalls, broad cloud networking constructs i.e. global availability zones and multi-cloud options.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

You will manage engineering and certification for the following technologies.

Core data center technologies - Cisco Nexus including ACI and Arista
DNS – Infoblox
Load balancing – F5
Cloud networking – Azure and AWS
CDN – Akamai and Cloudflare

You will also need to

Manage the implementation of multiple concurrent initiatives of varying complexity in a time efficient manner. Monitor and control activities according to plan.
Continuously identify potential issues, conflicts, and risks. Analyze, mitigate and escalate where appropriate
Develop and execute on end to end change management plans and plan and execute all communication related to these.
Collaborate and contribute on cross-functional enterprise initiatives and manage the effective implementation of assigned deliverables.
Establish strong working relationships across business units and platforms to build influence and impact with key business partners. Collaborate with groups to define and achieve deliverables and ensure initiatives are effectively integrated into RBC procedures and processes.
Contribute to ongoing administrative program activities as required.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

Must have:

Undergraduate degree coupled with change management experience in complex programs with high frequency of requests and multiple priorities.
Demonstrated ability in written and oral communication skills along with strong presentation skills. Ability to determine the information and communication needs of the stakeholders and project.
Strong organizational, project management and time management capabilities.
A strong understanding of technology and/or financial services industry.
Deadline-driven and results-oriented; able to meet consistently high quality standards while handling a variety of tasks and deadlines simultaneously.

:

Ability to facilitate between and influence key decision makers

new_jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Strategy
new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274044

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Scotiabank Enterprise Strategy group is a high-performing central team focused on designing and advancing Scotiabank’s strategic agenda
. The team works closely with the CEO, Group Heads and senior leaders to shape the Bank’s enterprise strategy and its most important business-line priorities.

Reporting to the VP, Enterprise Strategy, the Director will work closely with senior executives, business-line leaders and stakeholders across the Bank to lead complex strategy engagements, generate insights and develop recommendations that shape the Bank’s most important priorities.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will be responsible for:

Strategy Projects – Must-Win Priorities
Lead a broad range of strategy engagements across the Bank, including business-line priorities and enterprise initiatives. Partner with stakeholders to structure complex problems, conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis, assess strategic and financial implications, and develop and present compelling recommendations to senior leadership.
Design and facilitate problem-solving sessions, workshops, and interviews with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts to generate insights, build alignment, and advance strategic priorities.
Build alignment across business lines and corporate functions to advance strategic priorities and drive enterprise outcomes.
Partner with business-line leaders to shape strategic priorities and support the development of plans aligned to the Bank’s broader strategic objectives.
Synthesize complex findings into clear recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and governance approaches, and present them effectively to senior leaders to drive strategic outcomes.
Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior executives, helping define priorities, assess trade-offs, and navigate complex strategic decisions.
Thought Leadership
Provide thought leadership and constructive challenge on the design and advancement of strategic priorities and must-win opportunities.
Monitor emerging trends, competitive dynamics, and strategic issues to assess their implications for the Bank and its business-line strategies.
Act as a strategic counsel and thought partner for senior executives – both within the context of strategy project and on an ongoing basis
Design and support executive strategy discussions and offsites, helping senior leaders evaluate key priorities, align on strategic direction, and address emerging opportunities and challenges.
Executive Communications
Support the CEO agenda, including all-bank strategy, business line value creation projects, strategic planning, Board-level communications, and being a trusted advisor to senior leaders
Develop clear, compelling presentations and communications that translate complex strategic issues into actionable insights for senior executives, Executive Committee, and Board audiences.
In partnership with Global Communications, develop executive communications and strategic messaging that clearly articulate the Bank's priorities to internal and external stakeholders. Support the planning and delivery of key leadership, employee, and external events.
Team Leadership and Stakeholder Management
Contribute to the growth and development of the Enterprise Strategy team through recruiting, coaching, mentorship, knowledge sharing, and fostering strong partnerships across the Bank.
Ensure the Bank's risk appetite and risk culture are appropriately considered in all activities, recommendations, and decisions.
Champion a high-performance environment and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops, and motivates top talent by fostering an inclusive work environment

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have the following:

MBA, PhD or relevant post-graduate degree from a recognized institution
3-4 years of experience in a top-tier management consulting firm; banking industry expertise is highly recommended
Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, challenging, and dynamic business environment
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to manage ambiguity
Superior interpersonal skills, leadership and influencing capabilities on a multi-cultural environment
Self-motivated; ability to work both independently and collaboratively with multi-functional teams
Experience running complex projects, with large group of cross-functional stakeholders
Ability to effectively manage relationships across the Bank, its partners, and external vendors
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
Collaborative and proven track record of managing and developing high-potential talent
Excellent knowledge of MS Office including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

What’s in it for you?

An inclusive & collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
We offer a competitive rewards package: Performance bonus, Employee Share Ownership Program, and Pension Plan Matching, Health Benefits from day one!
Your career matters! You will have access to career development and progression opportunities.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.
